recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-38731; if FHIR-53971 is reconciled separately, treat it as a later no-change restructuring decision rather than a reason to modify this implementation.
issue_request: FHIR-38731 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking to add Appointment.cancellationDate after Appointment.created as a 0..1 dateTime with the requested short and definition, add an app-4-like invariant requiring cancellationDate only when status is noshow or cancelled, and update the rejection/cancellation flow to set cancellationDate when cancelling an appointment.
initial_application: Commit 4c9aaa5a7e73955b2c066974523dd1300f24c75a applied the issue by adding Appointment.cancellationDate and updating appointment-notes.xml. Commit 9b24283fc116fa7861fbd9b2d49c0c6b57ee800d later wired app-7 as a condition on Appointment.status and Appointment.cancellationDate, and commit 213511a2bbeb1f8f671c7b2f7af2b9d599fe7965 added an app-7 negative invariant test.
additional_context: Appointment is an active, FMG-approved current build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later issue FHIR-53971 was Resolved - No Change after PA considered restructuring cancellationDate and cancellationReason into a backbone element; the resolution and PA minutes retained cancellationReason near status and cancellationDate near created. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion, and Confluence evidence supports the current placement.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already has the requested element, invariant, condition wiring, and cancellation-flow narrative, and no missing parallel source location was found.
